originalEntry.title: Hand-drawn collage animation of an About page
originalEntry.title_zh: 手绘拼贴风「关于我们」动画
originalEntry.author: TomAndrieu96707
originalEntry.description: A 52-second whimsical hand-drawn collage animation in pure JavaScript, with audio, retelling a company's About page story using assets from its repo.
originalEntry.description_zh: 纯 JavaScript 写的 52 秒手绘拼贴风动画，带音频，用仓库里的素材讲出官网「关于我们」页的故事。
originalEntry.prompt: Create a pure javascript animation. 30s-60s whimsical hand drawn collage style with appropriate audio that will explain the same story as our “about-us” page. Use assets from our repo when possible.
originalEntry.prompt_zh: 做一段纯 JavaScript 动画。30 到 60 秒，异想天开的手绘拼贴风格，配上合适的音频，讲出和我们“about-us”页面一样的故事。尽量使用我们仓库里的素材。
